description: This file implements packing and unpacking functions for PSUP PDU session information, including serialization/deserialization of various fields according to 3GPP specifications.

classes.name: psup_packing
classes.description: Class providing methods to pack and unpack PSUP PDU session information.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes a byte buffer into a psup_dl_pdu_session_information structure, interpreting various fields according to protocol specifications.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes a psup_dl_pdu_session_information structure into a byte buffer, adding necessary padding and encoding fields.
